subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in no-auth Firecrawl web_search provider, or keep Firecrawl search credentialed unless a maintainer sponsors that hosted-query boundary?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and live Firecrawl keyless search works, but it creates a new official provider id and a hosted third-party query path that require maintainer privacy/product acceptance.

options.title: Accept opt-in Firecrawl keyless search
options.body: Merge the two-provider shape after maintainer sign-off, relying on explicit selection, no auto-detect, no Authorization header, and current Firecrawl docs/live behavior.

options.title: Keep Firecrawl search credentialed
options.body: Pause or close the keyless provider portion and keep the already-merged keyless support limited to the Firecrawl web_fetch path.

options.title: Split provider from tool parity
options.body: Land only the `firecrawl_search` option parity and revisit `firecrawl-free` as a separately sponsored provider decision.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in Firecrawl keyless search
recommendation.body: Merge the two-provider shape after maintainer sign-off, relying on explicit selection, no auto-detect, no Authorization header, and current Firecrawl docs/live behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc authored the scoped keyless Firecrawl scrape implementation and reviewed the key-free web-search opt-in policy that bounds this decision.
